name: Continuity Pins
description: Fast note of up to three facts the next reply could get wrong: who's there, what they hold or wear, injuries, where they are. Don't run it with: Continuity Companion, Scene Tracker, Status Tracker, Item Tracker.
author: Purachina
prompt:
{{// Fast pre-generation note. Up to three facts, inserted just before the main model writes.}}{{trim}}
Read the recent scene in the context. List up to three facts the next reply is most likely to get wrong. Pick from:
- who is present, and who has left
- what each character is holding or wearing
- injuries, restraints or other physical states
- where everyone is, and the time of day
- anything a character has just promised, revealed or refused

Write one short line per fact, stated plainly as it stands now, for example: Mara's left hand is bandaged.

Only use facts the context establishes. Never guess. If nothing stands out, write where the scene is and who is present. Write only the lines.
